mapper.select: select t.id as leaveTypeId, t.name as leaveTypeName, t.status as status, coalesce(sum(case when l.entry_type = 1 then l.change_hours else 0 end), 0) as grantedHours, coalesce(sum(case when l.entry_type = 3 then l.change_hours else 0 end), 0) as creditedHours, coalesce(-sum(case when l.entry_type = 2 then l.change_hours else 0 end), 0) as deductedHours, coalesce((select sum(v.hours) from attendance_leave v where v.applicant_id = #{userId} and v.leave_type_id = t.id and v.status = 1 and v.is_deleted = 0), 0) as pendingHours from attendance_leave_type t left join attendance_leave_ledger l on l.leave_type_id = t.id and l.user_id = #{userId} and l.is_deleted = 0 where t.is_deleted = 0 and t.balance_required = 1 group by t.id, t.name, t.status, t.sort_no order by t.sort_no asc, t.id asc
